title: Ansāb al-Ašrāf
bookshelves: Category: Biography, Literature and Literary studies
summary: Ansāb al-Ašrāf is a genealogical encyclopedia of the Arab-Islamic state. This volume contains biographies of the later Umayyad (Marwānid) caliphs. Each biography of these deals with the policies of the concerned caliph and his governors, his children, and his internal and external relations, as well as with rebellious movements in his era.
